top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock is a complete, independently reproduced and inter-laboratory compared achievement. The magic-wavelength idea (Katori) and its development to the 1e-18 level with coherent many-body control (Ye) give a distinct route to stability, not a repeat of the comb or ion-trap prizes. The two-name allocation and citation are scoped to that concept and its realisation, and I do not think the committee should wait for the redefinition of the second. An unresolved overlap with the 2005 and 2012 prizes and the omitted contributors remain, but they do not outweigh a mature, well-verified instrument-driven discovery over no award.
